description:
Refactor the 'order-service' project to change the data type of the 'id' field in the 'Order' class from 'int' to 'long'. This change is necessary to prevent integer overflow as the system scales.

You should use IntelliJ IDEA's 'Type Migration' refactoring feature to ensure the change propagates correctly to all dependent classes (Repository, Service, Controller). 

Expected Outcome:
1. The 'id' field in 'com.ecommerce.model.Order' is of type 'long'.
2. All methods referencing this ID (getters, setters, repository finders) are updated to use 'long'.
3. The project compiles successfully ('mvn compile').
4. All tests pass ('mvn test').
